todos.title: Add your first document or memory
todos.why: Searches need something to find. Upload a document or add a memory so your agents have context to search.

todos.title: Run your first searches from an agent
todos.why: The list can only tell you what to fix once agents have searched. Connect an agent and run a few searches.

todos.title: Add context for 73 searches that found little or nothing
todos.why: These searches found little or nothing, usually because the datapack does not cover the topic yet. Add a memory or a document that answers them, then re-run them to check.

todos.title: Make 14 vague prompts more specific
todos.why: Short prompts and follow-ups give the search too little to match on. Asking with the subject and the detail wanted helps it find the right context.
